blocks.translation:
• This product is for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to children under the stated age.
• This product contains small parts and batteries; keep it away from young children so they do not accidentally swallow them. There is a risk of choking.
• Do not use this product near the ears. Incorrect use may damage hearing.
• Do not put fingers or other objects into moving parts. They can be pinched and cause injury.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED lights. Doing so may cause nausea or other adverse effects.
• This product contains electronic components; people with pacemakers should take precautions.
• If you use batteries incorrectly they may overheat, burst, or leak. Observe the following precautions.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert the batteries with the correct +/− (polarity).
• After playing, always turn the switch off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If a battery is swallowed, or battery leakage gets into the eyes, consult a doctor immediately. If leaked fluid contacts skin or clothing, wash with water.
• Button batteries are dangerous if swallowed. Store them out of children's reach.
• When disposing of batteries, follow your local municipality's waste-disposal instructions.

blocks.translation:
• Precautions for Use
• The buckle is fully painted. Depending on how you handle it, the paint may get scratched or peel off, so take care.
• The battery installed in the Gaia Memory is for testing. Replace the battery if the sound becomes faint or the light grows weak.
• This product contains delicate electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it where temperatures become very high or very low.
• Do not place this product on resin sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not pull or bend moving parts or attachment parts strongly in a direction they are not meant to move.
• Some voice lines have different intonation or may be hard to hear because of the product's characteristics.
• Do not insert anything other than the Gaia Memory into the main unit; doing so may cause malfunction. Inserting commercially available USB memory devices may cause damage. Also, the included Gaia Memory cannot be used with computers.
• If the unit malfunctions, press the reset button and turn the power back on.
• Appearance may vary between units due to the product's characteristics.
• Do not insert the included Gaia Memory into products other than compatible items such as CSM Double Driver ver.2 or CSM Double Driver ver.1.5.
• The product may malfunction from other infrared remotes such as TV remotes.
• The product may malfunction outdoors in direct sunlight. Play with it indoors. If it malfunctions, turn the power off and on again.

この項目では、 CSMダブルドライバーver.2の進化点をすぐに体験できる、おすすめの遊び方を紹介します。
詳しい遊び方は、p.4 「目次」より、 それぞれの内容をご確認ください。
blocks.translation:
• This section introduces recommended ways to play that let you quickly experience the advancements of the CSM Double Driver ver.2.
• For detailed playing instructions, check each entry in the table of contents on p.4.

• In Line Mode, a short press of the button plays the "Transform!" shout from memory, and special-attack voice lines include calling shouts by Shoutaro and Philip.
• The Cyclone Joker memory contains different variations of the "Transform!" line. See the table below for details.

詳しい遊び方は、p.4 「目次」より、 それぞれの内容をご確認ください。

おすすめは、 「1:1人で劇中再現モード」です。

blocks.translation: Repeatedly inserting and removing the Gaia Memory may leave scuff marks on the Gaia Memory because of its construction.

blocks.text: 変身後決め台詞遊び
さあ、おまえの罪を数えろ!

※台詞が鳴らない場合、メモリとドライバーの通信が失敗してる可能性があります。 一度ドライバーを閉じ、 「閉じ音」が鳴り終わった後に
再度展開してください。
blocks.translation: If voice lines do not play, the memory and driver may have failed to communicate. Close the driver once, wait until the "closing" sound finishes, then open it again.

blocks.text:
①ドライバーにメモリを1回目に装填すると、「装填音」と「メモリ転送音 (前半)」が鳴ります。
②その後、ドライバーからメモリを引き抜くと 「メモリ転送音 (後半)」が鳴ります。
③再度ドライバーにメモリを装填すると「装填音」と「変身待機音」が鳴ります。
④その状態でもう片方にメモリを装填し、 「装填音」が鳴り終わった後にドライバーを展開すると「変身音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
① When you insert a Memory into the Driver for the first time, the "insertion sound" and the "Memory transfer sound (first half)" will play.
② After that, when you pull the Memory out of the Driver, the "Memory transfer sound (second half)" will play.
③ When you insert the Memory into the Driver again, the "insertion sound" and the "transformation standby sound" will play.
④ While in that state, insert a Memory into the other side. After the "insertion sound" finishes, deploy the Driver to play the "transformation sound."

決め台詞を鳴らすことが可能です。
blocks.translation: In the <post-transformation state>, press and hold both phrase buttons at the same time to play the signature line "Now, count your sins!" at any time.

blocks.text: ダブルドライバーの電源の入れ方/モード切替
blocks.translation: How to turn on the Double Driver / Switching Modes

blocks.text: 各部名称
電源の入れ方
blocks.translation: How to turn the power on

blocks.text:
電源スイッチをONに入れます。
→「起動音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
• Turn the power switch ON.
• →The start-up sound will play.

blocks.text: モード切替スイッチについて

「2」:2人で1人モード
ダブルドライバー2つを使って、
ドライバー間の通信遊びを
行うモード
blocks.translation:
• "2": Two-person-as-one mode
• Use two Double Drivers to play communication-based games between the drivers.

blocks.text: 「O」:DXモード

「メモリ転送音」等を鳴らさず、
DX版と同じように遊ぶモード
blocks.translation: Mode to play like the DX version without playing the "memory transfer" sound or other similar sounds.

blocks.text:
電源スイッチをONに入れた状態で
モード切替スイッチを 「2」に入れます。
「2人で1人モード」の状態に移行します。
blocks.translation: With the power switch ON, set the mode selector switch to "2". The toy will switch to "Two people, one player" mode.

blocks.text:
電源スイッチをONに入れた状態で
モード切替スイッチを 「O」に入れます。
「DXモード」の状態に移行します。
blocks.translation:
• With the power switch turned ON, set the mode change switch to "O".
• The unit will switch to "DX mode".

blocks.text: ※モード切替ボタンを操作すると、ダブルドライバーの音声などは中断し、状態がリセットされます。
blocks.translation: If you operate the mode-change button, any Double Driver voice or other sounds will be interrupted and the device’s state will be reset.

blocks.text: モード切替スイッチ
[裏側から見た図]
電源スイッチ

モードは3種あります。 電源スイッチをONにした状態で、モード切替スイッチを 「2/1/0」 にすることで、下記の各モードに移行します。
1人で遊ぶ場合のおすすめはこちら
blocks.translation:
There are three modes. With the power switch set to ON, set the mode selector switch to "2", "1", or "0" to switch to the corresponding mode below.
Recommended setting when playing alone is shown here.

blocks.text: 「1」:1人で劇中再現モード

ダブルドライバー1つで、
「メモリ転送音」が付加された
変身遊びを行うモード
blocks.translation: A mode to play transformation using one Double Driver, with added "Memory transfer" sounds.

blocks.text:
電源スイッチをONに入れた状態で
モード切替スイッチを 「1」に入れます。
「1人で劇中再現モード」の状態に
移行します。
blocks.translation:
With the power switch set to ON, set the mode selector switch to "1".
The Double Driver will enter "Solo Scene Re-enactment Mode".

blocks.text: ガイアメモリのモード切替

各ガイアメモリのボタンを2.5秒間長押しします。
短押し時の音声が鳴った後、そのまま長押しを続けると
「装填音」が鳴り、表の順にモードが切り替わります。
blocks.translation:
• Press and hold the button on each Gaia Memory for 2.5 seconds.
• After the short-press voice plays, keep holding the button a “loading” sound will play and the mode will change in the order shown on the chart.

blocks.translation: About communication between the Driver and Memory

blocks.text:
ガイアメモリ ver.2は、ドライバー(左右)が閉じている状態のダブルドライバー本体と赤外線通信を行います。
メモリを装填した際の 「装填音」が鳴り終わるまで通信を行う為、 「装填音」が鳴り終わる前にドライバー(左右)を展開すると通信が
失敗する場合がございます。
blocks.translation:
• Gaia Memory ver.2 communicates by infrared with the Double Driver main unit while the driver (left/right) is closed.
• The unit keeps communicating until the “insertion sound” that plays when a memory is loaded finishes, so if you open the driver (left/right) before that sound ends, communication may fail.

太陽光の当たらない室内で遊んでください。
blocks.translation:
• If communication fails, firmly close the Driver and wait until the “close” sound finishes, then open it again.
• When communication fails, a memory with a silver terminal will play the voice it would make when loaded in the Driver (right), and a memory with a gold terminal will play the voice it would make when loaded in the Driver (left).
• If communication keeps failing, replace the batteries and try again.
• Communication only occurs while the Driver is closed. If you swap memories while the Driver is open, it will not recognize the form.
• Direct sunlight can prevent the infrared sensor from responding properly and may cause communication to fail. Play indoors out of direct sunlight.

blocks.text: 必殺技遊び

①メモリをマキシマムスロットに装填します。
「必殺技待機音」が鳴ります。
② マキシマムスロットのボタンを押します。
下記表の 「必殺技音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
• 1) Insert the Memory into the Maximum slot. The "special attack standby" sound will play.
• 2) Press the Maximum slot button. The "special attack" sound shown in the table below will play.

blocks.text:
※破損の原因になるため、
図の方向以外で装填しないでください。
blocks.translation: Do not insert it in any direction other than the one shown in the diagram; it may cause damage.

blocks.text:
※変身時のメモリの組み合わせによって「必殺技音」 や 「必殺技待機音」が下記表のように変化します。
※同一のフォームで複数の必殺技が存在するメモリ(ヒートメモリ/メタルメモリ/トリガーメモリ)は、メモリをドライバーから引き抜いた後に
メモリのボタンを押すことで必殺技を選択することができます。(選択時にメモリが0.5秒発光します。)
※一度必殺技を選択したメモリは、スリープ状態になるまで選択した必殺技の状態を保持します。 新たに必殺技を選択したい場合は、上記の1 の動作から
再度行ってください。
※下記の必殺技音が鳴らない場合、メモリとドライバーの通信が失敗してる可能性があります。
一度ドライバーを閉じ、 「閉じ音」が鳴り終わった後に再度展開してください。
blocks.translation:
• The combination of Memories used during transformation changes the “special attack sound” and the “special attack standby sound” as shown in the table below.
• For Memories that have multiple special attacks for the same form (Heat Memory / Metal Memory / Trigger Memory), you can select a special attack by pulling the Memory out of the Driver and then pressing the Memory’s button. (The Memory will light for 0.5 seconds when selected.)
• Once a Memory’s special attack is selected, it will keep that selection until the Memory enters sleep mode. To select a different special attack, repeat the step described above as step 1.
• If the special attack sounds below do not play, communication between the Memory and the Driver may have failed. Close the Driver once, wait until the “close” sound finishes, then open it again.

blocks.text: フィリップボタン:
台詞
ぞくぞくするねえ。
検索を始めよう。
行くさは2人で1人の探偵だもの。
blocks.translation: The two of us together make one detective.

blocks.text: 2人で1人の探偵さ。
blocks.translation: Two people together are one detective.

blocks.text: 検索を完了した。
それを言うならが、だろ?
blocks.translation: If you're going to say that, it's me, right?

blocks.text: あの日と同じ事を、今もう一度くよ、 翔太郎。 これからも、悪魔と相乗りする勇気、 あるかな?
blocks.translation:
• I'll tell you the same thing I said that day, Shoutarou.
• Do you still have the courage to ride with a devil?

blocks.text: 対策なんか、働いてから立てればいい。
blocks.translation: You can decide on countermeasures after you start working.

blocks.text: 行くよ、相棒。
強いだけのダブルに価値はない。 キミの優しさが必要だ、翔太郎。
blocks.translation: A Double that's only strong has no value. Your kindness is needed, Shoutarou.

blocks.text: 行こう、相棒。
キミの友である事は、僕のりさ。
blocks.translation: Being your friend is my duty.

blocks.text: 止めるさ。 何度でも。 この左翔太郎が街にいるかぎり。
blocks.translation:
• I'll stop you.
• As many times as it takes.
• As long as Shotaro Hidari is in this town.

blocks.text: いくよ翔太郎、最後の・・・。

魔と相乗りする勇気あるかな?
blocks.translation: Do you have the courage to share the ride with a demon?

blocks.translation: I'll put a stop to it. I will... No, *I* will.

blocks.translation: Oyassan used to say, "Eighty percent of a man's work is making decisions. Everything after that is just an extra."

blocks.text: 止めてやるよ俺が必ず。
俺は、いや、俺達は、鳴海荘吉の忘れ形見。 2人で1人の探偵で、仮面ライダーだ。

blocks.translation: Philip! You... don't tell me you're going after Fang!? Hey, you've got a plan, right?

地獄の底まで、と相乗りしてくれ、翔太郎。 来い! ファング!
blocks.translation: Ride with me all the way to the depths of hell, Shotaro. Come! Fang!

blocks.text: ああ、フィリップ。
いきなりヒートで行こう。
blocks.translation: Let's go straight to the heat.

blocks.text: ありがとよ・・・フィリップ・・・。
相棒、それを言うなら、 は、 だろ?
blocks.translation: Partner, if you're going to put it that way, shouldn't it be...?

blocks.text: そうだった。アイツが俺を相棒と呼ぶ限り、俺は折れない。約束だった・・・。
blocks.translation: That's right. As long as he calls me his partner, I won't break. That was the promise...

blocks.text: それがもし、弱さだとしても、僕は受け容れる。
blocks.translation: Even if that is a weakness, I will accept it.

変身。

source_blocks.translation: To pursue and defeat the enemy—that very spirit is what makes one a Kamen Rider. Don't forget: Kamen Rider is here in this city.

source_blocks.text: 1人でよくやったね。 すごいよ
source_blocks.translation: You did well on your own. That's amazing.

source_blocks.text: キミの友である事は、僕のりさ。
source_blocks.translation: Being your friend is my pride.

source_blocks.text: さあ、おまえの罪を数えろ!
止めるさ。 何度でも。 この左翔太郎が街にいるかぎり。
source_blocks.translation: I'll stop it. Time and time again. As long as I, Shotaro Hidari, am in this city.

source_blocks.text: いくよ翔太郎、最後の・・・。
おっといけね、忘れてたぜ・・・さあ行こうか、フィリップ。
source_blocks.translation: Oops, my bad—I'd forgotten... Alright, let's go, Philip.

source_blocks.text:
<変身前状態>でフィリップ台詞ボタンと翔太郎台詞ボタンを同時に短押しします。
下記表の「二人の変身前掛け合い台詞」が鳴ります。
source_blocks.translation:
While in the <pre-transformation state>, briefly press both the Philip dialogue button and the Shotaro dialogue button at the same time.
The "pre-transformation dialogue exchange between the two" listed in the table below will play.

source_blocks.text: たちは2人で1人の探偵さ。 行くぜフィリップ。
source_blocks.translation: We're two people who are one detective. Let's go, Philip.

source_blocks.text: 止めてやるよ俺が。 必ず。 それを言うなら俺達が、だろ?
source_blocks.translation: I'll stop you. I will—definitely. If you're going to put it that way, it should be "we," right?

source_blocks.text: 俺は、いや、運は、鳴海荘吉の忘れ形見。 2人で1人の探偵で、仮面ライダーだ。 行くぜ、フィリップ。 ああ。
source_blocks.translation: I'm—no, we're—the last remnant of Sokichi Narumi. We're a two‑in‑one detective and a Kamen Rider. Let's go, Philip. Yeah.

source_blocks.text: フィリップ!おまえ･･･まさかファングを!? おい、何かがあるんだろうな! 対策なんか、動いてから立てればいい。
source_blocks.translation: Philip! You... don't tell me you're after Fang!? Hey, you've got something planned, right? We can work out countermeasures after we move.

source_blocks.text: 強いだけのダブルに価値はない。 キミの優しさが必要だ、翔太郎。 それがもし、さだとしても、僕は受け容れる。 ありがとよ･･･フィリップ･･･。 行こう、相棒。
source_blocks.translation: A Double that's only strong has no value. I need your kindness, Shotaro. Even if that's fate, I'll accept it. Thanks... Philip... Let's go, partner.

source_blocks.text: 僕は人間で、 探偵で、 そして、仮面ライダーだ! 相棒、それを言うなら、僕は、だろ? あぁ。 行くよ、 翔太郎。
source_blocks.translation: I am human, a detective, and a Kamen Rider! Partner—if you're going to say it that way, shouldn't it be "I"? Yeah. Let's go, Shotaro.

source_blocks.text: 1人でよくやったね。 すごいよ。 約束を守っただけだよ。 キミの友である事は、僕の誇りさ。
source_blocks.translation: You did well on your own. That was amazing. I just kept my promise. I'm proud to be your friend.

source_blocks.text:
止めるさ。 何度でも。 この左翔太郎が街にいるかぎり。 たとえおまえらがどんなに強大な悪でも、都を泣かせるヤツは許さねえ。体ひとつになっても食らいついて倒す、その心そのものが仮面ライダーなんだ。
この街には仮面ライダーがいる事を忘れんなよ。
source_blocks.translation:
I'll stop you. No matter how many times. As long as I, Shotaro Hidari, am in this city. No matter how great the evil you are, I won't forgive anyone who makes this city cry. Even if I'm down to just my own body, I'll bite and bring you down—that very heart is what a Kamen Rider is.
Don't you forget: there's a Kamen Rider in this city.

source_blocks.text: 財団X! さあ、おまえの罪を数えろ!
source_blocks.translation: Foundation X! Now, count your sins!

source_blocks.text: いくよ翔太郎、最後の･･･。ああ、最後の!
source_blocks.translation: Here we go, Shotaro—the last one... Yeah, the last one!

source_blocks.text: おっといけね、忘れてたぜ・・・さあ行こうか、フィリップ。 ああ、相棒。
source_blocks.translation: Oops, almost forgot... Alright, let's go, Philip. Yeah, partner.

blocks.text: 効果音ボタン遊びく変身後>

<変身後状態>でメモリがドライバーに2本装填されている状態で
効果音ボタンを押し、 または長押しすると
変身しているフォームに応じて、下記表の「固有音声」が鳴ります。
下記表の、鳴る順番 「O」の音声は「変身遊び」をした後の
初回操作で鳴ります。 その後は1・2・3の音声が繰り返し鳴ります。
blocks.translation: When two Memories are loaded in the driver in the <After-Transformation State>, short-press or long-press the effect-sound button to play the form-specific voice listed in the table below. The sounds marked “O” in the table play the first time after performing a “transformation play” action; afterward the sounds 1, 2 and 3 repeat in sequence.

blocks.text:
※正しい効果音が鳴らない場合、
メモリとドライバーの通信が失敗してる可能性があります。
一度ドライバーを閉じ、 「閉じ音」が鳴り終わった後に
再度展開してください。
blocks.translation: If the correct sound effects do not play, communication between the memory and the driver may have failed. Close the driver once, and after the “closing sound” finishes, open it again.

blocks.text: 2つのダブルドライバーの通信範囲について
blocks.translation: About the communication range between two Double Drivers

blocks.text:
2つのダブルドライバーの「赤外線送受信センサー」が向かい合った状態で、
ダブルドライバー間の距離は1m以内(障害物無し)を目安としてください。
※週信がうまくいかない場合は近づいて再度通信を行ってください。
太陽光の当たる場所では赤外線センサーが正常に反応せず、通信が失敗する可能性があります。太陽光の当たらない室内で遊んでください。
blocks.translation:
• With the two Double Drivers' infrared transmit/receive sensors facing each other, keep the distance between them within 1 m (no obstacles) as a guideline.
• If communication fails, move the units closer and try communicating again.
• Direct sunlight can prevent the infrared sensors from responding properly and may cause communication to fail. Play indoors away from direct sunlight.

blocks.text: ベルト出現遊び

2つのダブルドライバーがく変身前状態>で赤外線送受信センサーが向かい合っている状態で行います。
片方のダブルドライバーから「ベルト装着音 (短縮版)」 または 「ベルト装着完了音」を鳴らします。
2つのダブルドライバーが赤外線通信を行い、もう片方のダブルドライバーから「ベルト出現音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
• Do this with the two Double Drivers in the pre-transform state so their infrared transmit/receive sensors face each other.
• From one Double Driver, play the “belt attach sound (short version)” or the “belt attachment complete” sound.
• The two Double Drivers communicate by infrared, and the other Double Driver will play the “belt appearance” sound.

blocks.text: 「ベルト装着音(短縮版)」、「ベルト装着完了音」の鳴らし方は、p.22をご参照ください。
blocks.translation: For how to play the “Belt Attach Sound (short version)” and the “Belt Attachment Complete Sound,” see p.22.

blocks.text: メモリ転送遊び

2つのダブルドライバーが<変身前状態>で赤外線送受信センサーが向かい合っている状態で行います。
片方のダブルドライバーに任意のメモリを装填します。
「メモリ転送音(前半)」が鳴り、もう片方のダブルドライバーから「メモリ転送音 (後半)」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
• Perform this with the two Double Drivers in <pre-transformation state> with their infrared transmit/receive sensors facing each other.
• Load any Memory into one of the Double Drivers.
• A "Memory Transfer Sound (first half)" will play, and the other Double Driver will play the "Memory Transfer Sound (second half)".

blocks.text:
※一度 「メモリ転送音(後半)」が鳴ったドライバーは<転送完了状態>として、メモリ転送の通信を受け付けなくなります。
<転送完了状態>を解除したい場合は、一度変身した後「変身解除音」を鳴らすか、電源を入れなおしてください。
※「メモリ転送音(前半)」が鳴らない場合、メモリとドライバーの通信が失敗してる可能性があります。
一度メモリを引き抜いた後、再度装填動作を行ってください。
blocks.translation:
• Once a driver plays the “Memory Transfer Sound (second half)”, it enters the <transfer complete state> and will no longer accept memory-transfer communication.
• To cancel the <transfer complete state>, transform once and then play the “Transformation Cancel Sound”, or turn the power off and then on again.
• If the “Memory Transfer Sound (first half)” does not play, communication between the memory and the driver may have failed.
• Remove the memory once, then reinsert it and perform the loading action again.
